target_customer: Employers hiring operational (blue-collar and service) staff in Latin America, plus job seekers on the HoyTrabajas platform
problem: Recruiting teams cannot screen the volume of candidates for operational roles, and job seekers lack access to formal job matching.
business_model: B2B SaaS / recruiting services for employers (pricing not found)
product_category: HR tech: AI candidate screening and recruitment (formerly HoyTrabajas job platform)

founders.name: Ruben Cordoba
founders.background_notes: Over 10 years of entrepreneurship, infrastructure project planning and fundraising, 3 years in recruiting and staffing (YC page).

founders.name: Sebastian Arce
founders.background_notes: YC page describes Sebastián as a technical co-founder with HR industry experience.

founders.name: Vladimir Guzman
founders.background_notes: YC page describes Vladimir as a technical co-founder with HR industry experience.

technical_complexity.rationale: Job marketplace and candidate-screening workflow software; the AI screening layer arrived later with LLM tooling and is not hard for a small team to build.

defensibility.rationale: Candidate and employer data in Latin America and local sales relationships help, but no strong structural moat was evidenced; the company claims 290 clients with over 40% of sales in Mexico.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No incumbent action found; company remains Active.

market_need_then: The company expected to help about 42,000 people find jobs in 2022 and positioned itself in operational hiring in LatAm; no independent market data retrieved.

pivots.from: HoyTrabajas job platform for operational workers
pivots.to: Talentropy.ai AI recruiting team that screens every candidate
pivots.why: Not stated in sources; the YC page now describes the AI recruiting product under the Talentropy.ai name.

outcome_analysis: HoyTrabajas raised a pre-seed from angels and Rockstart, joined YC Winter 2022 and announced a $5M seed in October 2022 with Newtype Ventures and many others, bringing reported capital to $5.5M. It is Active with 35 to 64 staff and 290 clients per the company, which supports a traction story, but later rounds and the date and reason for the rebrand to AI recruiting were not found.
notes: Funding conflicts: one source says $3.5M seed, another $2M round, totals vary $5.5M to $9.5M; $5M seed (LatamList, 14 Oct 2022) is most consistent. Team size conflicts (35 vs 64) and founding year (2018 per LatamList, 2019 per YC). Strong_pmf is inferred from client count and is low-confidence. Competitors not recorded.
